$note: portfolio: Nuxt/Vue + pnpm. By design (see CLAUDE.md) the only tooling is Prettier — no lint, no tests; vue-tsc is not installed, so `tsc --noEmit` is NOT a valid typecheck for a Nuxt project. Files are auto-formatted on edit by the global format hook. `build` is `nuxt build`.
$stopCheck_note: Empty = no blocking stop-gate (portfolio has no fast, deterministic correctness check yet, and the repo is not fully Prettier-clean). To turn one on: run `pnpm exec prettier --write .` once to clean the tree, then set stopCheck to ["format"] and change checks.format to `pnpm exec prettier --check .`; OR install vue-tsc and set checks.typecheck to `pnpm exec nuxt typecheck`, then stopCheck to ["typecheck"].
